court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Family Court No. 7, Lucknow (Case No. 746 of 2026)
case_name: Smt. Baby @ Bebi vs Abhay Gupta
facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent filed a petition under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The trial court fixed the matter for mediation and directed the parties to appear on 22.04.2026. The petitioner moved an application seeking waiver of the cooling period.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking waiver of cooling period to establish justifiable grounds.
legal_principles.held: The contention that one of the parties had already resolved to re-marry fixing 15.04.2026 as the date of marriage without seeking divorce, in itself is not a valid ground and it cannot also give rise to any justifiable ground for waiving of the cooling of period.
cited_cases: Amardeep Singh v. Harveen Kaur; (2017) (8) SCC 746

legal_principles.principle: The court will not waive the cooling period unless there are justifiable grounds.
legal_principles.held: There was no urgency in the matter and since the mediation was already fixed on 22.04.2026, hence, there was no justifiable ground to waive of the cooling period.

outcome.final_order: The High Court directed the Additional Principal Judge, Family Court No. 7, Lucknow to expedite the hearing of the petition.
